capabilities.description: Manage comprehensive patient (animal) records including owner details, medical history, vaccinations, allergies, and clinical notes, accessible to authorized staff.
Schedule, reschedule, and track appointments across veterinarians, with calendar views, reminders, and status updates for receptionists and vets.
Document and manage treatments, prescriptions, procedures, and clinical observations, linking them to patient records and notifying relevant staff.
Generate invoices from treatments and services, calculate totals with formulas, process payments, and produce billing statements for clients.
Track medical supplies, medications, and retail inventory with stock levels, reorder alerts, and usage tracking tied to treatments.
Maintain an immutable, searchable log of all system activities including record access, modifications, and financial transactions for compliance and security.
Define and enforce role-based access controls for vets, receptionists, and admins, ensuring data privacy and operational boundaries.
Provide dashboards and reports on clinic performance, patient outcomes, revenue, and inventory trends to support decision-making.

summary: VetClinicOS is an integrated practice management platform for veterinary clinics, serving vets, receptionists, and admins. It centralizes patient (animal) records, appointment scheduling, treatment documentation, billing and invoicing, and supply inventory, while maintaining a complete, tamper-evident audit trail for regulatory compliance and operational accountability.
